options.concept: An open steel vault and one oversized gold key turn the first step toward abs into a valuable secret being unlocked.
options.plate_prompt_9x16: Create an empty premium advertising background plate, portrait 9:16, 1080x1920. A monumental circular steel vault stands open inside a deep navy room, with saturated blue edge lighting and restrained gold reflections. Place the open vault door along the right edge, its circular geometry framing the lower central area. One oversized, clearly recognizable gold key rests diagonally against the far-left wall at mid-height, away from the headline area. Use broad shapes, realistic metal and strong contrast that reads at phone size; avoid intricate machinery. Reserve the upper 30 percent as relatively plain dark navy for a headline added later. Reserve the lower central 65 percent for a real photographic cutout of Dan added later; keep that area dark and uncluttered behind his skin and dark green shorts. Do not render Dan or the headline. No people, bodies, text, letters, numbers, logos, signs with writing, watermarks, money imagery, before-and-after imagery or stomach close-ups.
options.plate_prompt_16x9: Create an empty premium advertising background plate, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. A monumental circular steel vault stands open inside a deep navy room, with saturated blue edge lighting and restrained gold reflections. Compose the open circular vault on the right, behind the future subject position. Place one oversized, clearly recognizable gold key near the lower middle, partially behind the future subject area and clear of the left headline area. Use broad shapes, realistic metal and strong contrast that reads at phone size; avoid intricate machinery. Reserve the left 53 percent as relatively plain dark navy for a headline added later. Reserve the right 40 percent for a real photographic cutout of Dan added later, framed from mid-thigh upward; keep that area dark and uncluttered behind his skin and dark green shorts. Do not render Dan or the headline. No people, bodies, text, letters, numbers, logos, signs with writing, watermarks, money imagery, before-and-after imagery or stomach close-ups.
options.dan_9x16: Centre bottom, dark green shorts with white trim; cutout occupies approximately x=0.13–0.87 and y=0.35–1.00, preserving his hair, face, hands and abs.
options.dan_16x9: Right side, approximately x=0.60–0.98, from mid-thigh upward; face and abs remain clear of the headline.
options.hero_words: KEY and ABS are largest and gold; THE and TO GETTING are smaller and white.
options.type_treatment: Centred stacked lettering with white #FFFFFF and gold #FFD348 fills, a navy #06172D outline and a hard black #000000 shadow offset down-right. No band or label.
options.design_line: A circular navy vault frames Dan beneath a centred gold-and-white headline, with heavy block lettering and a single oversized key.

options.concept: A glowing photographic lightbox makes the picture itself feel like the powerful first step.
options.plate_prompt_9x16: Create an empty contemporary photographic-gallery advertising background plate, portrait 9:16, 1080x1920. Use a saturated cobalt-blue room with a large upright rectangular photographic lightbox behind the future subject, extending from approximately x=0.10 to x=0.90 and y=0.34 to y=0.98. Its interior is a deep blue blank surface, with a thick electric-cyan illuminated perimeter; it contains no picture, silhouette or markings. Show slight gallery-wall depth and a restrained blue floor reflection. Make the rectangular frame bold and instantly readable at phone size. Reserve the upper 29 percent as uncluttered cobalt for a headline added later. Reserve the lower central 64 percent for a real photographic cutout of Dan added later, wearing bright green shorts; keep the lightbox interior dark enough to separate his skin and shorts. Do not render Dan or the headline. No people, bodies, text, letters, numbers, logos, signs with writing, watermarks, money imagery, before-and-after imagery or stomach close-ups.

Illuminate it with warm orange light and a crisp shadow. Keep the scene bold, tactile and minimal, with no small props. Keep the wall behind him charcoal for strong skin and clothing contrast. Do not render Dan or the headline.
